subcommittees.name: Public Lands, Forests, and Mining Subcommittee

dimensions.assessment: Affects oil and gas applicants submitting new permit applications to the Bureau of Land Management, as well as BLM operations.
dimensions.evidence: extends through FY2037 the Bureau of Land Management's (BLM's) authority to collect oil and gas permit processing fees.

dimensions.assessment: Continues existing fee collection and fund transfer mechanisms for an additional 11 years without altering the underlying process structure.
dimensions.evidence: transfer, for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2037, all of the fees collected under this subsection... to the BLM Permit Processing Improvement Fund

dimensions.assessment: Extends fee collections and revenue transfers into the BLM Permit Processing Improvement Fund through 2037.
dimensions.evidence: Section 35(d) of the Mineral Leasing Act (30 U.S.C. 191(d)) is amended...(1) in paragraph (1), by striking '2026' and inserting '2037'

dimensions.assessment: Amends a specific section of the Mineral Leasing Act to prolong existing administrative fee and fund authorities.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Mineral Leasing Act to extend the period of time during which the Secretary of the Interior is required to collect a fee for each new application for a permit to drill

dimensions.assessment: Extends authorities and fund transfers through fiscal year 2037.
dimensions.evidence: extends through FY2037 the Bureau of Land Management's (BLM's) authority to collect oil and gas permit processing fees.

missing_information: Total projected revenue to be collected from the extended fees.
importance_detail.rationale: Extends the Bureau of Land Management's authority to collect oil and gas permit processing fees and transfer them to the BLM Permit Processing Improvement Fund through fiscal year 2037.
